nodes.odebrane.text.t: The notebook slides into the slot with a rustle, as if it wanted to go in. A moment later there are footsteps on the stairs, then Brygida's voice: "Someone's brought another one?" Something is left in the box for you.

nodes.s.text.t: By the tower door stands an iron box with a slot for letters. Someone has scrawled on it in chalk: "Only the important things get lost in here."
